Based on the provided onboarding document, there is no mention of a built-in font size adjustment setting or dedicated desktop app configuration for Hermes Agent.

**Best Guess / Temporary Workaround:**
Since the UI is served as a local web dashboard (`hermes dashboard` at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`), you can adjust the font size independently from the rest of your system by using standard browser zoom controls (`Ctrl + +` / `Cmd + +` or browser-level font size settings).
